tools.name: inspect_image_c2pa
tools.description: Fetch a single image (by CSS selector or URL) and return its fully decoded C2PA manifest store: every manifest's claim, assertions (e.g. c2pa.actions edit history, schema.org authorship), and the COSE signature details (algorithm and signing-certificate identity). Provide exactly one of `selector` or `url`. Note: the signature is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

selector.description: CSS selector for an element on the page.

url.description: Image URL (absolute, or relative to the current page) to fetch and inspect.

tools.name: plan_route
tools.description: Plan an EV route using manual vehicle range, battery capacity, battery targets, waypoints, and station/network preferences. Authentication is optional; responses include an overview and a "see route on map" link.

waypoints.description: Ordered route waypoints. The first point is origin and the last point is destination.

vehicleId.description: Public catalog vehicle id used to fill range and battery defaults.

subtypeId.description: Optional catalog variant id; requires vehicleId.

garageVehicleId.description: Owned garage vehicle id used to fill route profile defaults.

rangeKm.description: Manual vehicle range in kilometers; required without a vehicle profile.

batteryCapacityKwh.description: Manual battery capacity in kWh; required without a vehicle profile.

arrivalBatteryTargetPercent.description: Minimum target battery percentage at arrival. Defaults to 15.

autoPlan.description: Whether the routing backend may add charging stops. Defaults to true.

allowFerries.description: Whether ferry routes are allowed. Defaults to false.

blockedStationIds.description: Station ids the planner must avoid.

preferredStationIds.description: Station ids the planner should prefer.

networkIds.description: Optional charging network ids to constrain or prefer.

routeMode.description: Route optimization mode. Defaults to fastest.

tools.name: scan_images_c2pa
tools.description: Scan every on the current page for C2PA Content Credentials (content provenance metadata) and return a per-image summary: whether a manifest is present, the claim generator (the tool that produced or edited the image), the title, and the signer name. Use this to find which images on a page carry provenance data. Note: provenance is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

limit.description: Maximum number of images to fetch and scan (default 25, max 100).
